newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential starts telecom stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Prudential starts telecom stocks.

text.p: -- Prudential Securities analyst Guy Woodlief, who recently joined the brokerage from Dean Witter, said he started six U.S. telecomunications providers as buys and another eight as neutrals.

-- The analyst said he started WorldCom Inc as a buy and put it on the firm's single best idea list. He also put buy ratings on MCI Communications Corp, Bell Atlantic Corp, GTE Corp and Ameritech Corp.
-- He also issued a buy rating on Sprint Corp which had been rated a buy by the previous analyst.

-- The analyst said he initiated eight telco providers with hold ratings including AT&T Corp, Frontier Corp, LCI International Inc, BellSouth Corp, NYNEX Corp Pacific Telesis, SBC Communications Inc and U S West Communications Group.
